verdict.rationale: ADP documents API Central, a separately purchased add-on with OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect auth and use-case API templates, which lets developers automate HR processes and share data in real time instead of using file imports. So a first-party API surface exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the RUN UI does, and the templated, use-case-scoped framing suggests coverage is selective, not complete. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, RUN-specific API coverage of core actions such as running payroll, tax filing, onboarding and reports, an API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.
